Services / Custom Software & Product Builds
01 · build

Software that's built to last past launch

Most MVPs get built fast and then can't scale. We architect from the data model up, so the thing you ship in month one is still the thing you're building on in year three.

Start a project →
the problem

Founders and teams often need software built quickly, but 'quickly' too often means shortcuts that create technical debt — no clear data model, no separation of concerns, no plan for what happens when the user base 10x's. That debt gets expensive fast.

our approach

We start with the data model and system boundaries before writing a line of UI code. Whether it's a web app, an internal tool, or a full platform, we design for the scale you'll actually hit, not just the demo you need next week — without over-engineering for scale you'll never reach either.

what's included
01

Architecture & data modeling

Entity design, system boundaries, and a modular structure that won't need a rewrite at 10x users.

02

Full-stack development

Frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure — one team accountable for the whole stack.

03

API design & integrations

Clean, documented APIs and third-party integrations (payments, messaging, maps, and more).

04

MVP to production path

A build plan that gets you to a real MVP fast without boxing you into a rewrite later.

05

Code review & handoff

Documented, reviewed code — whether we maintain it long-term or hand it to your internal team.

06

Ongoing iteration

Feature work and improvements after launch, folded into Managed Digital Support if you want it.
